# Notre Dame Law School

> A Catholic law school offering JD, LL.M., and J.S.D. degrees with specializations in business, criminal, environmental, intellectual property, and global law, alongside clinics and international programs.

Notre Dame Law School is located in South Bend, Indiana and is part of the University of Notre Dame. The school emphasizes Catholic legal education, experiential learning through clinics, and global lawyering initiatives including the London Law Programme and partnerships with institutions like Insper in Brazil.

## Key Topics

- Catholic legal education
- JD program
- LL.M. and J.S.D. degrees
- Religious Liberty Clinic
- Global Lawyering Initiative
- London Law Programme
- Business Law specialization
- Criminal Law specialization
- Environmental and Energy Law
- Intellectual Property & Technology Law
- Student clinics and experiential learning
- Career Development Office
- Faculty scholarship and mentoring
- Study abroad programs
- ABA accreditation

## Core Programs & Academics

- [Academics](https://law.nd.edu/academics): Academic programs, curriculum, specializations, clinics, and experiential learning
- [Business Law](https://law.nd.edu/academics/programs-of-study/business-law): Business Law program: corporate law, tax law, and commercial law specialization
- [Criminal Law](https://law.nd.edu/academics/programs-of-study/criminal-law): Criminal Law program: criminal justice, procedure, and international criminal law
- [Energy & Environmental Law](https://law.nd.edu/academics/programs-of-study/environmental-law): Environmental and Energy Law program covering natural resources and land use
- [Intellectual Property & Technology Law](https://law.nd.edu/academics/programs-of-study/intellectual-property-technology-law): IP and Technology Law program: patent, copyright, trademark, and tech law
- [Global Law](https://law.nd.edu/academics/programs-of-study/global-law): Global Law program: international studies, comparative law, and London Programme

- [Global Lawyering Initiative](https://law.nd.edu/global): Global programs, LL.M., J.S.D., London Law Programme, and international partnerships
- [Lindsay and Matt Moroun Religious Liberty Clinic](https://law.nd.edu/religious-liberty): Religious Liberty Clinic promoting religious freedom through scholarship and advocacy
